comment: The select jack accepts 1V to 16V, one slot per volt; the range field is limited to the spellings this project allows and cannot say 16. Parameter 6, the random recall button, is never passed to configButton and so carries no tooltip. In polyphonic mode outputs 2 to 8 are never written again and hold whatever they last carried.
